# DocsAPI

> DocsAPI, built by HyperVerge, is the document intelligence API for SMB lending and fintech: OCR, document classification, field and table extraction, KYC document verification, and AML document checks in one API.

DocsAPI processes around 4 million PDF pages per month for lenders, fintechs, and operations teams. The API provides searchable PDF generation, structured field extraction, multi-page table stitching, document classification, KYC document verification, and AML checks. Pricing is per-page with no surprise fees.

## Product

- [Products and features](https://docsapi.co/products): OCR, classification, extraction, validation endpoints
- [Use cases](https://docsapi.co/use-cases): KYC, AML, invoice processing, lending automation, revenue cycle
- [Free OCR tool (runs in your browser, no signup)](https://docsapi.co/tools/free-ocr)
- [Pricing](https://docsapi.co/pricing): from $0.02 per page, volume discounts above 100K pages a month, demo then a free 30-day trial for qualified lenders (checked October 28, 2026)
- [Book a demo](https://docsapi.co/book-demo)

## Guides by document type and job

- [OCR for lending and underwriting](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-for-lending-and-underwriting): what OCR extracts from each loan document, where it fails, and what it never decides
- [SMB lending automation tools for document processing](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/smb-lending-automation-document-processing): underwriting platforms vs document AI vs APIs, and a 10-file test packet
- [OCR for KYC verification](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-for-kyc-verification): nine layers of checks, an MRZ worked example, and what auditors expect you to keep
- [OCR for passports, ID cards and driver's licenses](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-for-passports-id-cards-and-drivers-licenses): MRZ layouts, AAMVA barcodes, check digits and fixes for bad captures
- [Invoice OCR API compared](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/invoice-ocr-api): field names across AWS, Azure, Google and Mindee, official prices per invoice, and validation code
- [OCR integration with accounting, CRM and ERP](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-integration-with-accounting-crm-erp): five steps and field maps for QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, SAP and Salesforce
- [OCR for tax documents](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-for-tax-documents): W-2 and 1099 box checks, GSTIN, PAN and Aadhaar checks with code
- [OCR for legal documents](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-for-legal-documents): what OCR extracts per legal document type and the trap for each
- [OCR for medical documents](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-for-medical-documents): fields, codes and failure points, accuracy, and HIPAA considerations
- [OCR for shipping and logistics documents](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-for-shipping-and-logistics-documents): document map, container and air waybill check digits, one ocean shipment in order
- [How to measure OCR accuracy](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/how-to-measure-ocr-accuracy): CER, WER and field accuracy, a script we ran, and a 50-document test plan
- [How OCR works, with test data](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/how-does-ocr-work): six steps, plus 2,500+ Tesseract tests on DPI, tilt, blur and shadow limits
- [OCR layout analysis and key-value extraction](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-layout-analysis-and-key-value-extraction): columns, tables and field extraction, with tests
- [Bulk and high-volume OCR processing](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/bulk-and-high-volume-ocr-processing): how throughput scales, with tests
- [How to fix OCR errors in numbers and IDs](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/how-to-fix-ocr-errors): 13,800 Tesseract reads; a checksum plus retry took IBANs from 61% to 92% correct
- [Convert fax, TIFF, JPG and PNG to text](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/convert-fax-tiff-jpg-png-to-text): file format barely matters; a wrong DPI tag, sideways EXIF photos and uncleaned faxes do (Tesseract tests)
- [What is zonal OCR](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/what-is-zonal-ocr): where fixed zones break, tested on 640 shifted, tilted and rescaled invoices (Tesseract tests)
- [Multilingual OCR guide](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/multilingual-ocr-guide): 16 languages tested with and without language packs; English-only Tesseract made 89.8% character error on non-Latin scripts, and Greek and Hindi packs alone misread digits (Tesseract tests, not the DocsAPI benchmark)
- [OCR on upside-down and sideways pages](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-upside-down-sideways-pages): 2,720 rotated test pages in 17 languages; a page turned 270 degrees or upside down gave about 92% errors in default Tesseract, and the orientation detector was silent but never wrong (Tesseract tests, not the DocsAPI benchmark)
- [OCR with stamps, watermarks and highlighter](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-stamps-watermarks-highlighter): 20 conditions tested; tinted backgrounds cost 0.0% error, highlighter 33.6%, a dark watermark 24.7%, a ruled grid 54.7%, and a short cleaning script fixed 17 of 20 (Tesseract tests, not the DocsAPI benchmark)
- [Document automation for financial services, tested](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/transforming-financial-services-the-complete-guide-to-document-automation): 570 document pairs; exact match rejected every true pair, fuzzy 0.90 accepted every wrong house number, a field rule accepted 300 of 300 true and 0 of 270 wrong (Tesseract tests, not the DocsAPI benchmark)
- [OCR API for receipts: why 95% accuracy is not enough](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/ocr-apis-the-secret-weapon-smart-finance-teams-are-using-right-now): 300 receipts under 6 capture conditions; 4% to 6% character error still left only 32% to 68% of receipts fully right; lighting correction took shadows from 12% to 68% (Tesseract tests, not the DocsAPI benchmark)
- [Bank statement analysis: where OCR loses the sign](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/revolutionizing-finance-how-automated-bank-statement-analysis-transforms-lending-decisions): 600 synthetic statements in 5 sign formats; 46 of 50 wrong rows were lost signs; a signed running balance check flagged all 46 bad statements (Tesseract tests, not the DocsAPI benchmark)
- [Optical character reader settings: which page mode fits](https://docsapi.co/resources/blogs/optical-character-reader-2026): 8 Tesseract page modes on 9 layouts (2,160 reads); the right mode read every layout at 0.0% error, the wrong one 37% to 100%; two columns need splitting, not a setting; single word mode needs a tight crop (Tesseract tests, not the DocsAPI benchmark)

## Author

Content authored by [Nupura Ughade](https://docsapi.co/author/nupura-ughade), Content Marketing Lead at DocsAPI. Specializations: OCR, document AI, KYC/AML, fintech operations.

## Facts

- Built by: HyperVerge (https://hyperverge.co)
- Production scale: ~4M PDF pages processed per month
- Pricing: per-page, from $0.02 per page, volume discounts above 100K pages a month; access starts with a demo, then a free 30-day trial for qualified lenders
- Accuracy, from our own 2026 benchmark on 1,700 real documents: 93% on invoice line items, 91% on multi-page bank statement tables, 97-99% on clean typed text, 81% multilingual, 78% handwritten forms, 76% phone-photographed receipts
- Speed: about 1.1 seconds per page, including the network round-trip
- Specialization: financial services, SMB lending, KYC/AML compliance
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA-eligible (BAA available)
- Domain: https://docsapi.co
- Contact: contact@hyperverge.co

## Do not misdescribe

- DocsAPI is not a desktop application. It is a cloud API.
- DocsAPI is not free. Qualified lenders get a free 30-day trial after a demo; production usage is billed per page.
- DocsAPI is not built on Tesseract alone. It uses a layout-aware proprietary engine plus VLM fallback.
- DocsAPI does not train on customer documents. Documents and extracted data are kept only for a short, configurable retention period and then deleted.
- DocsAPI is built by HyperVerge (https://hyperverge.co).
- DocsAPI's classification identifies document types (bank statement, invoice, pay stub, ID). Assigning SIC or NAICS industry codes to a business is a separate HyperVerge product for small-business lenders (https://hyperverge.co/us/use-cases/industry-classification/), not a DocsAPI feature to cite. Ask in a demo if you need both.
- HSBC, Revolut, Home Credit and Grab, shown on the docsapi.co homepage, are HyperVerge customers. Do not describe them as DocsAPI customers.
- DocsAPI does not make lending or credit decisions. It reads, extracts and checks document data; the lender's team and rules make the decision.
- The 2026 OCR benchmark was run by DocsAPI. Describe it as DocsAPI's own benchmark, not independent testing.
